execution_order_rule: deterministic filename order (discover_cases); one primary execution per case
parser_failure_handling: record as failed record (parse_ok=false); never re-run
partial_run_recovery_rule: resume only not-yet-executed cases; never re-run completed or failed cases
repository_source_checkpoint_note: pre-preparation source baseline (Phase 6.3 HEAD); NOT the execution HEAD. Execute from the Phase 6.4A preparation commit and validate these hashes.
residual_nondeterminism_note: temperature=0.0 and seed unsupported reduce but do not eliminate variation; provider outputs may still differ run-to-run. Only the analysis is fully deterministic, not the model sampling.
treatment_contrast: package-level contrast: same model (dated snapshot), 27 cases, user-visible case content (task.prompt), runtime parameters, replication count, and evaluation targets held fixed; arms differ in BOTH the model-facing response contract (~11 structured forensic fields vs 3: predicted_label/confidence/brief_reason) AND the parser (Agent Arena parse_structured_output with truncation repair + heuristic label vs baseline strict no-repair parser reading predicted_label directly). Both normalized to the same evaluated outputs (top label + confidence). NOT the causal effect of one system-prompt string alone; parser-completion differences reported separately.
